Scope: Selected fields from existing reports. Null verdict means not supplied by original report. No automatic functional acceptance.

Reports.Condition: param($value) $speed=[Math]::Sqrt($value.velocity.x*$value.velocity.x+$value.velocity.z*$value.velocity.z);if($value.agl -gt 6 -or $speed -gt 20){throw 'Unexpected taxi motion; abort this test'};return $speed -ge 3 -and $value.engine.RPM.left -gt 65
